# Open source — lirantal.com

Liran Tal’s curated open-source portfolio: security tools, developer resources, upstream contributions, and dated evidence of impact. This is a selection, not a mirror of his GitHub profile.

- [Overview](https://lirantal.com/open-source)
- [Projects and resources, with involvement credits and source links](https://lirantal.com/open-source/projects)
- [Ecosystem contributions, with merged pull request evidence](https://lirantal.com/open-source/contributions)
- [Impact, rankings, dates, and metric definitions](https://lirantal.com/open-source/impact)
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/lirantal)
- [GitRanks profile for current ranks and history](https://gitranks.com/profile/lirantal)
- [Research and disclosures](https://lirantal.com/research)

Download totals cover five selected npm packages in a stated window, including dependency installs, and are not unique developers. Stars and forks cover six featured repositories. Yearly profile contributions include qualifying commits, issues, PRs, and reviews. Merged-PR totals cover public PRs outside the lirantal namespace, including organization and professional work. These snapshots have different dates and scopes and must not be added together.

The GitRanks snapshot was supplied by Liran Tal on November 6, 2026; the profile reports an update on November 4, 2026. It places the profile in the top 0.1% worldwide for stars, contributor reach, and followers. Selected positions include #845 worldwide by contributor rank and #1 in Israel for JavaScript and PHP. Contributor rank uses stars on others’ repositories with merged PRs, counting each repository once, not commit or PR volume. Its 89 contributed-to repositories have a different scope from the direct GitHub search’s 193 repositories. Follow the linked profile for changing ranks.
